messages.content: 計算一輛以每秒50公尺的速度移動的汽車行駛600公尺所需的時間。同時計算一顆以每秒400公尺的速度移動的子彈行駛1000公尺所需的時間。

function.name: physics_calculate_force
function.description: Calculate the force required to move an object of a particular mass at a particular acceleration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

mass.description: The mass of the object in kg.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2.

function.name: kinematics_calculate_time
function.description: Calculate time required for an object to travel a particular distance at a particular velocity. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

velocity.description: The velocity of the object in m/s.

distance.description: The distance covered by the object in meters.

message.content:
行駛時間可以直接用公式 \(t=\frac{d}{v}\) 計算：

1. **汽車**：  
   - 速度 \(v = 50\ \text{m/s}\)  
   - 距離 \(d = 600\ \text{m}\)  
   - 時間 \(t = \frac{600}{50} = 12\ \text{s}\)

2. **子彈**：  
   - 速度 \(v = 400\ \text{m/s}\)  
   - 距離 \(d = 1000\ \text{m}\)  
   - 時間 \(t = \frac{1000}{400} = 2.5\ \text{s}\)

因此，汽車需要 12 秒完成 600 公尺，而子彈需要 2.5 秒完成 1000 公尺。
